name: OS Command Injection
summary: Untrusted input reaches a shell or process launcher and can change which command runs.
python_patterns: subprocess.* with shell=True and user input
mitigations: pass an argument list with shell=False
shlex.quote only as a last resort

name: SQL Injection
summary: Untrusted input is spliced into a SQL statement, letting an attacker change the query.
python_patterns: cursor.execute with f-strings, % formatting, .format or + concatenation
raw SQL in ORM .raw() or text() with interpolation
mitigations: never interpolate identifiers from user input

name: Code Injection
summary: Untrusted data is evaluated or compiled as code.
python_patterns: eval or exec on request data
mitigations: explicit dispatch tables instead of eval

name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
summary: Deserializing attacker-controlled bytes can execute code or build dangerous objects.
python_patterns: pickle.load/loads on network or file input

name: Path Traversal
summary: User input builds a file path that escapes the intended directory.
mitigations: resolve the path and confirm it stays under the base directory

name: Hard-coded Credentials
summary: Secrets such as passwords, API keys or tokens are embedded in source.
mitigations: load secrets from environment or a secret manager

name: Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
summary: Weak or obsolete algorithms are used where security depends on them.
python_patterns: hashlib.md5 or sha1 for passwords or signatures
mitigations: bcrypt, scrypt or argon2 for passwords

name: Weak PRNG for Security
summary: A non-cryptographic random generator produces tokens, keys or nonces.
python_patterns: random.random/choice/randint for tokens, passwords or session IDs

name: Server-Side Request Forgery
summary: The server fetches a URL that the user controls, reaching internal services.
mitigations: block private and metadata IP ranges after DNS resolution

name: XML External Entity (XXE)
summary: An XML parser resolves external entities from untrusted documents.
python_patterns: xml.dom.minidom or sax on untrusted XML
mitigations: disable entity resolution and DTD loading

name: Cross-site Scripting
summary: User input is written into HTML without escaping.
python_patterns: returning f-string HTML with request data

name: Improper Certificate Validation
summary: TLS certificate checks are disabled, enabling interception.
mitigations: pin a CA bundle for internal services

name: Sensitive Information in Logs
summary: Secrets or personal data are written to logs.
python_patterns: logging passwords, tokens or full request bodies

name: Inefficient Regular Expression (ReDoS)
summary: A regex with nested quantifiers backtracks catastrophically on crafted input.
python_patterns: patterns like (a+)+ or (.*)* applied to user input

name: Insecure Temporary File
summary: Predictable temp file names allow races or symlink attacks.

name: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
summary: A sensitive endpoint or action can be reached without authentication.

name: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key (IDOR)
summary: An object is fetched by an ID from the request without checking the caller owns it.
mitigations: scope queries to the current user

name: Active Debug Code
summary: Debug features ship to production and expose internals or code execution.
